svg.title: Startup readiness
svg.desc: CHeklist hotovnosti kharchovoi line do pershoho vyrobnychoho zapusku.
svg.text: Before the first batch the line must be systematically ready

g.text: □ equipment is installed by scheme and accessible for maintenance
□ sensors are calibrated, valves and pumps checked
□ CIP, drains, emergency modes and interlocks are tested
□ operators have instructions, recipes and parameter limits
□ first batch has a quality control and reject plan
□ deviations, corrections and decisions are recorded
